name: cfar_maps
description: 2-D CFAR on fixed stored power maps P[r, d] (row-major, Doppler circular, range clipped). Inputs are stored (no RNG needed). For each K and kind: threshold T, per-cell alpha (T = alpha * statistic), detections (P > T) as [r, d]. Statistic: CA mean of training cells; GO/SO max/min of the means of the leading (dr < 0, or dr = 0 and dd < 0) and lagging halves, alpha for n = min(nLead, nLag) cells; if min(nLead, nLag) < nTrain/4 the cell falls back to CA with the Gamma(K) CA alpha for nTrain cells (caFallbackCells); OS: k-th smallest training cell, k = round_half_even(0.75 nTrain) clipped to [1, nTrain]. alpha is the exact Gamma(K) value for the actual cell count (K = 1: closed forms).
